A plural noun reaches the singular domain the catalog spells, ahead of actions that only mention issues in a parameter (issue 1121).
An es plural reaches its singular in either word order; the value branches of an enum in pipeline.list no longer wins (issue 1121).
A read of a plural asks for many, so the list of the domain the plural names ranks over a get of one item (issue 1121).
A plural lifts the list action whose ID spells it, not a list action of another domain that carries the word among its tags (issue 1121).
A plural of commit reaches repository.commit_list through the singular the catalog spells; with the ref tags of its optional ref, pipeline.list would have reached commit as strongly (issue 1121).
An optional ref names no resource, so pipeline.list, whose ref only filters its pipelines, no longer ranks first for commits as the ref tags made it (issue 1121).
A plural misspelled with a plain s still reaches the singular the catalog spells.
A plural inside a longer read reaches the list of the resource it names, ahead of a get of one job (issue 1121).
A plural under a destructive verb gains no list preference, so the destructive action it names stays first.
Merge is the first word of the domain merge request names, not a verb, so a verbless plural of it asks for the list and never for merge_request.merge (issue 1121).
A scope word before the plural of a compound domain still asks for the list of that domain (issue 1121).
An action named by the plural itself ranks above lists that only hold its singular, and the singular forms no compound tag such as ssh key (issue 1121).
A plural of artifact asks for the archive the plural names, not for the single artifact its singular reaches (issue 1121).
The singular of a plural feeds no intent that reads the query's words, so a query naming no scope keeps the instance list of service accounts first (issue 1121).
A verb the verb intent does not know keeps a plural from asking for a list, even where a synonym of it is a word of a list action's ID, so the action that closes an issue stays first (issue 1121).

A required ref names the point its action starts from, so the commit a branch is created from lifts branch.create, and repository.commit_create, which takes the branch to commit to, does not answer (issue 1121).
The singular of repositories is the repository domain, whose actions read one repository's content, so its list of submodules must not take the list of projects' place (issue 1121).
Nonsense queries should remain zero-result.
